authority: blinded retained-profile recognizability pre-check input; no candidate selection authority

features.description: Frame a disagreement as two opposing concerns before addressing either side.
State the speaker's current practice, uncertainty, or limitation directly instead of presenting every conclusion impersonally.
Answer a complex disagreement through numbered sections and compact pointwise responses.
Acknowledge the valid portion of an objection before identifying the narrower point of disagreement.
Interrupt formal analysis with a compact analogy, aside, or lightly humorous clarification.
Compress a longer distinction into a short parallel summary after the detailed explanation.
Repeatedly state a familiar framing and immediately replace it with a more precisely bounded alternative.
Follow a compact thesis with numbered or bulleted consequences that move from failure conditions to practical implications.
Use short, high-commitment declarative sentences for the central evaluation, followed by the limiting explanation.
Mark that a criticism concerns adequacy for the stated purpose rather than denying every use of the criticized approach.
Use brief reader-facing transitions to flag a consequential distinction before explaining it.
Keep each paragraph focused on one main point.
Use ordinary transition words when moving between related points.
Prefer direct sentences whose subjects and actions are easy to identify.
Add a brief qualification when a statement does not apply universally.
End with a concise restatement of the main point.
Introduce an evaluation through a short parallel series of guiding questions.
Move from a general observation to examples, a bounded contrast, and a resulting implication through restrained connective language.
Present categories in compact parallel grammatical forms so their differences remain visually comparable.
State the practical consequence of a condition directly, then explain the evidence or mechanism behind it.
Mark the evidential maturity of a generalization and distinguish observations, tendencies, and established results.

classifier_contract.blindness: The classifier receives only the generated packet: anonymous card identifiers, abstract retained feature descriptions, salience weights, this contract, and no repository access or prior conversation.
classifier_contract.prohibited_inference: Do not infer, name, or search for authors, disciplines, source works, candidate identities, or the intended winner; evaluate only the linguistic information in the packet.
classifier_contract.score_scale: Use integer scores from 1 (absent or indistinguishable) through 5 (strongly present or readily distinguishable); score the cards independently before selecting the most neutral card.
classifier_contract.task: Judge whether each anonymous feature card describes an internally coherent and non-neutral linguistic register, and judge how readily each pair of cards can be distinguished using only the listed features.
